purpose: Scale from a small high-precision seed to high-recall structural instance candidate generation while preventing missing labels from becoming silent background.

column: Generate candidates from visible plan-footprint graphics and repeated symbol families.
Use nearby structural designations and legend context as semantic evidence, not as a substitute for the visiba”e instance.
beam: Generate candidates from visible framing graphics supported by W/C/other reliable structural designations and drawing context.
Do not silently relabel joists, trusses, bracing, dimensions, grids, leaders, or slab edges as beam.
wall: Start with the two human-confirmed positive pages and the regional semantics  already confirmed by the project user.
Generate tight axis-aligned source-page boxes only around visible structural wall graphics.
Never infer hidden continuation, bridge openings, or convert paired boundaries to engineering centerlines.

qa_policy.bulk1rule_approval: Allow only after a representative family has been human-reviewed and the rule is stable within the same drafting convention.

scaling_loop: 1. Generate many candidates per in-scope page.
2. Cluster candidates by drafting convention and visual/semantic family.
3. Human-review representative families rather than asking for every instance.
4. Bulk-apply a verified rule only within its verified drafting convention.
5. Route outliers and ambiguous cases back to human QA.
6. Run label-completeness and duplicate gates before training.
7. Train/evaluate only after class coverage and missing-label contamination gates pass.

future_extensibility.note: Future classes require their own versioned ontology/annotation/validation migration; they are not active v0.2 classes.

boundary.gpt6_owns: engineering geometry, transforms, scale, connectivity, topology, Core mapping and StructuralModel
